description: Standard Sword Agent OS profile. This is not a minimal demo.

port_policy.conflict_policy: Default fixed ports are preserved as the standard contract. Port conflicts must be reported as blocked, unavailable, or degraded; runtime tooling must not kill unowned processes automatically.
port_policy.notes: Isolated override ports are first-class validation evidence for local development and multi-thread work, while manifest default ports remain the standard endpoint contract.

startup_stages.meaning: No basic runtime reflex response is available; treat the OS as not alive enough to operate.
The OS substrate can return a simple liveness or status reflex without requiring full thought-core turn processing.
The OS can process a deterministic minimum text turn without requiring external AI/API access, return response events, and project the result into status and event history.
The OS can complete the configured full turn path with external AI/API access and expected integration surfaces such as expression forwarding and standard service probes.

readiness_policy.conscious_ready: Must be testable without external LLM/API access, network-dependent model calls, audio devices, display targets, or home devices.
readiness_policy.full_conscious_ready: May depend on configured secrets, external LLM/API access, network state, and optional organ service integrations.

health_model.availability_policy: Standard organ capabilities may be blocked, unavailable, or degraded without making OS boot unhealthy unless a profile explicitly marks them boot-critical.
